## Relevant Symbols
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:176` — `cfg() { jq -r "$1" "$CONFIG"; }`: `jq -r '.x // empty'` prints an empty string for missing/null/false, so `[ -n "$USD_CAP" ]` is the "set" test.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:194` — the two `// 20` / `// 100` defaults this item removes (comment cites "user decision 2026-10-22"; HEF-19 supersedes it).
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:219` — `awk … 'BEGIN { exit !(t + c > d) }'`: with an empty `c` awk reads 0, with an empty `d` it reads 0 → an empty daily cap would refuse every launch, so the check must be skipped, not just fed empty values.
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:221` and `:556` — the only two consumers of `CAP_HIT`; both read the same variable, so fixing `CAP_HIT` covers both paths (FR-003, FR-005).
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:618` — `--max-budget-usd "$USD_CAP"` is inside the array literal; it must move to a conditional `CMD+=(--max-budget-usd "$USD_CAP")`. Position: the 9.2.0 fixture (`tests/fixtures/launch-920.txt:9`) has the flag right after `--settings '…'` and before `--output-format`; `tests/smoke-spec-roots.sh:58` compares byte-for-byte, so the flag must stay at that position when set (split the array literal around it).
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:696-699` — budget block keyed on result subtype; unreachable without a cap but harmless; message names `$USD_CAP` (set whenever the CLI could report that subtype).
- `hooks/ledger.sh:429`, `hooks/ledger-actions.sh:248` — entries carry `budget.usd_cap: null` already; untouched.
- `tests/smoke.sh:2317` — sets `daily_usd_cap = 0` with `usd_cap 5`: both set → today's rule, still hits (0+5>0). Unchanged.

## Existing Patterns & Conventions
- Config read with jq defaults in one line per key (`hooks/session-launch.sh:186-194`, `:209`).
- Every guard test carries an inline `sed` mutation of the launcher into a temp dir and asserts the suite goes red (`tests/smoke.sh:2309-2315`, `l3_mut` at `:5457`) — constitution principle 3.
- Dry-run output is the assertion surface for the command line (`tests/smoke.sh:1963-1967`, `:1993`).
- Error messages name the value and the remedy (`CAP_MSG`, `:218`).
- Evals scaffold explicit caps (`evals/*/scaffold.sh`) — unaffected.

## Open Questions
- None blocking. The item text's "missing usd_cap → no daily check" vs. a project that sets only `daily_usd_cap` is decided in spec D1 (each cap independent; daily-only refuses at spent ≥ cap).
